purpose: Bounded paired renderer-conditioned temporal capture and state-response probing; offline research only

tranche_target.pair_split_policy: sequence_level_train_validation_test; keep both members of a pair in one split

state_response_pair.definition: Two rows with byte-identical current input, native guides and renderer conditioning but different valid teacher history

cache_contract.normalization: UNORM unchanged, signed decoded normals, float x/(1+x) for HDR-like unsigned stages
cache_contract.alignment: map native guides and renderer stages to teacher crop before fixed BOX downsampling

promotion_gates.ordinary_mae: retain existing all-ordinary-cohort rule and target <= 0.011
promotion_gates.temporal: full contiguous streams, reset-qualified, no mid-reset, report warmup and steady behavior
promotion_gates.visual: both eyes, teacher/student A-B sheets for face, skin, highlights, shadows, fur and foliage
promotion_gates.runtime: offline evidence only until separate runtime/headset/stereo/frame-budget acceptance
promotion_gates.promotion_requires: independent checkpoint replay, full training-fit audit, and no frozen-test tuning
